meaning.en: to be very tired, with no strength left
meaning.de: sehr müde sein, keine Kraft mehr haben

equivalent.de: erschöpft sein, erledigt sein, geschafft sein

literal.en: wear = to wear/erode; out = until nothing is left → used until finished
literal.tr: wear = giymek/aşındırmak; out = bitene kadar → kullanıla kullanıla eskimiş

usage.en: be/feel worn out → the tired one. wear sb out (separable) → the tiring one. wear yourself out → tire yourself. Also of things: worn-out shoes.
usage.tr: be/feel worn out → yorulan. wear sb out (ayrılabilir) → yoran. wear yourself out → kendini yormak. Eşyalar için de: worn-out shoes.

collocations.en: completely worn out · worn out from/by sth
collocations.tr: completely worn out · worn out from/by sth

sentences.en: I'm completely [worn out] — I've been on my feet since six.
sentences.tr: Bittim resmen, altıdan beri ayaktayım.
sentences.de: Ich bin völlig erledigt – ich bin seit sechs Uhr auf den Beinen.

sentences.en: The kids [wore me out] today.
sentences.tr: Çocuklar bugün canımı çıkardı.
sentences.de: Die Kinder haben mich heute geschafft.

meaning.en: to be completely drained of energy (far beyond tired)
meaning.de: völlig ohne Energie sein (weit mehr als müde)

literal.en: exhaust = to use up, to empty

usage.en: exhausted from/by sth · exhausting = very tiring. Extreme adjective: ✗ very exhausted → absolutely / completely exhausted.
usage.tr: exhausted from/by sth · exhausting = çok yorucu. Uç sıfat: ✗ very exhausted → absolutely / completely exhausted.

sentences.en: I'm [exhausted] from all the travelling.
sentences.tr: Bu kadar yolculuktan bitkin düştüm.
sentences.de: Ich bin erschöpft vom vielen Reisen.

sentences.en: Sorry, I can't come out tonight — I'm absolutely [exhausted].
sentences.tr: Kusura bakma, bu akşam çıkamam, tamamen tükendim.
sentences.de: Tut mir leid, ich kann heute Abend nicht mitkommen – ich bin total fertig.

expressions.expr: be beat / wiped (out) — be knackered / shattered

meaning.en: to be very tired (the everyday versions of exhausted)
meaning.de: sehr müde sein (die Alltagsvarianten von exhausted)

equivalent.de: fix und fertig sein, platt sein, kaputt sein

literal.en: beat = beaten · wiped out = wiped away · shattered = smashed to pieces
literal.tr: beat = dövülmüş · wiped out = silinip süpürülmüş · shattered = paramparça

variety.en: beat, wiped (out): AmE · knackered, shattered: BrE
variety.tr: beat, wiped (out): AmE · knackered, shattered: BrE

usage.en: Predicate only: I'm beat. ✗ a beat person. "knackered" is also used of things: broken, worn out.
usage.tr: Sadece yüklem olarak: I'm beat. ✗ a beat person. "knackered" eşya için de: bozuk, hurda.

sentences.en: I'm [beat]. I'm going straight to bed.
sentences.tr: Bittim. Doğruca yatıyorum.
sentences.de: Ich bin platt. Ich gehe direkt ins Bett.

sentences.en: I'm absolutely [knackered] after that shift.
sentences.tr: O vardiyadan sonra leşim çıktı.
sentences.de: Nach dieser Schicht bin ich fix und fertig.

meaning.en: to have had your emotional/mental energy especially sucked out
meaning.de: vor allem seelisch und geistig ausgelaugt sein

literal.en: with the water let out (drain = to empty of liquid)

usage.en: be/feel (emotionally/mentally) drained · sth drains sb · draining = something that uses you up
usage.tr: be/feel (emotionally/mentally) drained · sth drains sb · draining = insanı tüketen

sentences.en: After that conversation with my mom, I feel completely [drained].
sentences.tr: Annemle o konuşmadan sonra bütün enerjim çekildi.
sentences.de: Nach dem Gespräch mit meiner Mutter fühle ich mich völlig ausgelaugt.

sentences.en: Being around him is so [draining].
sentences.tr: Onun yanında olmak insanı çok yoruyor.
sentences.de: In seiner Nähe zu sein ist so anstrengend.

meaning.en: to be used up and unmotivated after long-term stress and overwork
meaning.tr: uzun süreli stres ve aşırı çalışma sonucu tükenmiş, hevesi kalmamış olmak
meaning.de: nach langem Stress und Überarbeitung verbraucht und unmotiviert sein

literal.en: burned until finished (a candle, a bulb, a match)

variety.en: burned out: AmE · burnt out: BrE
variety.tr: burned out: AmE · burnt out: BrE

usage.en: be/feel/get burned out → state. burn out (intransitive) → process. burn yourself out → to use yourself up. burnout (noun).
usage.tr: be/feel/get burned out → durum. burn out (geçişsiz) → süreç. burn yourself out → kendini tüketmek. burnout (isim) → tükenmişlik.

note.en: Not used for one day's tiredness; it takes weeks or months of build-up.
note.tr: Bir günlük yorgunluk için kullanılmaz; haftalar/aylar süren birikim gerekir.

sentences.en: I'm totally [burned out] — I haven't had a real day off in months.
sentences.tr: Tamamen tükendim, aylardır doğru dürüst izin yapmadım.
sentences.de: Ich bin total ausgebrannt – ich hatte seit Monaten keinen richtigen freien Tag.

sentences.en: If you keep working like this, you're going to [burn out].
sentences.tr: Böyle çalışmaya devam edersen tükeneceksin.
sentences.de: Wenn du so weiterarbeitest, brennst du aus.

meaning.en: to feel crushed under tasks or emotions, as if you can't cope
meaning.tr: işlerin/duyguların altında ezilmek, başa çıkamayacak gibi hissetmek
meaning.de: sich von Aufgaben oder Gefühlen erdrückt fühlen, als käme man nicht mehr klar

equivalent.de: überfordert sein, jemandem wächst alles über den Kopf

literal.en: whelm (archaic) = to be engulfed by a wave; over = going over the top
literal.tr: whelm (eski) = dalganın yutması; over = üstünden aşarak

usage.en: be/feel/get overwhelmed (by/with sth) · overwhelming. Can be positive too: overwhelmed by all the support (deeply moved).
usage.tr: be/feel/get overwhelmed (by/with sth) · overwhelming = bunaltıcı. Olumlu da olabilir: overwhelmed by all the support (çok duygulanmak).

sentences.en: I feel so [overwhelmed] with everything I have to do this week.
sentences.tr: Bu hafta yapmam gereken şeylerin altında eziliyorum.
sentences.de: Ich fühle mich so überfordert von allem, was ich diese Woche erledigen muss.

sentences.en: It's a bit [overwhelming] at first, but you'll get used to it.
sentences.tr: Başta biraz bunaltıcı ama alışırsın.
sentences.de: Am Anfang ist es etwas viel, aber du gewöhnst dich daran.

meaning.en: to have so much work that you can't look up
meaning.de: so viel Arbeit haben, dass man nicht mehr aufsehen kann

equivalent.de: in Arbeit ersticken, bis über beide Ohren in Arbeit stecken

literal.en: swamp = marsh, to flood · snowed under = buried under snow
literal.tr: swamp = bataklık, su basmak · snowed under = karın altında kalmış

variety.en: swamped: AmE + BrE · snowed under: mainly BrE
variety.tr: swamped: AmE + BrE · snowed under: ağırlıklı BrE

usage.en: be swamped (with work) · be snowed under (with sth). Describes workload more than feeling.
usage.tr: be swamped (with work) · be snowed under (with sth). Duygudan çok iş yoğunluğunu anlatır.

sentences.en: I'd love to, but I'm [swamped] at work this week.
sentences.tr: Çok isterdim ama bu hafta işten başımı kaldıramıyorum.
sentences.de: Ich würde gern, aber ich ersticke diese Woche in Arbeit.

sentences.en: I'm [snowed under] with coursework at the moment.
sentences.tr: Şu sıralar ödevlere gömülmüş durumdayım.
sentences.de: Ich stecke im Moment bis über beide Ohren in Uniaufgaben.

expressions.expr: have a lot on one's plate

meaning.en: to have many tasks or problems to deal with at once
meaning.tr: aynı anda uğraşılacak çok iş/sorun olmak
meaning.de: viele Aufgaben oder Probleme gleichzeitig haben

equivalent.tr: başında çok iş olmak, yükü ağır olmak

literal.en: to have a lot on your plate

usage.en: have a lot / too much / enough on your plate
usage.tr: have a lot / too much / enough on your plate

sentences.en: I can't take on another project — I've got [a lot on my plate] right now.
sentences.tr: Yeni bir proje alamam, şu an başımda çok iş var.
sentences.de: Ich kann kein weiteres Projekt übernehmen – ich habe gerade viel um die Ohren.

sentences.en: She's got [so much on her plate] with the move and the new job.
sentences.tr: Taşınma ve yeni iş derken yükü çok ağır.
sentences.de: Mit dem Umzug und dem neuen Job hat sie so viel um die Ohren.

expressions.expr: be bored to death / out of one's mind

equivalent.de: sich zu Tode langweilen, vor Langeweile sterben

literal.en: bored to the point of death / of losing your mind
literal.tr: ölesiye sıkılmış / aklını kaçıracak kadar sıkılmış

usage.en: bored to death / to tears / out of my mind · bored with/of sth · boring = causing boredom
usage.tr: bored to death / to tears / out of my mind · bored with/of sth · boring = sıkıcı

sentences.en: I was [bored out of my mind] in that lecture.
sentences.tr: O derste sıkıntıdan patladım.
sentences.de: Ich habe mich in der Vorlesung zu Tode gelangweilt.

sentences.en: I'm [bored to death] — let's go do something.
sentences.tr: Çok sıkıldım, hadi bir şeyler yapalım.
sentences.de: Ich sterbe vor Langeweile – lass uns etwas unternehmen.

meaning.en: (1) I've finished (2) that's enough; I have no patience or energy left for it
meaning.tr: (1) bitirdim (2) artık yeter; uğraşacak sabrım/gücüm kalmadı
meaning.de: (1) ich bin fertig (2) es reicht; ich habe keine Geduld oder Kraft mehr dafür

equivalent.tr: bitti benim için, artık yeter, pes
equivalent.de: fertig sein mit etwas, durch sein mit etwas, es reicht

usage.en: I'm done. · I'm (so) done with sb/sth. A tone of weariness + giving up; one step beyond "fed up".
usage.tr: I'm done. · I'm (so) done with sb/sth. Bıkkınlık + vazgeçme tonu; "fed up"tan bir adım sonrası.

sentences.en: I'm so [done with] this semester.
sentences.tr: Bu dönemden artık gına geldi.
sentences.de: Ich bin so durch mit diesem Semester.

sentences.en: I'm [done]. I'm not arguing about this anymore.
sentences.tr: Benden bu kadar. Bu konuyu artık tartışmıyorum.
sentences.de: Mir reicht's. Ich streite nicht mehr darüber.

meaning.en: breakdown: a serious psychological collapse (also as everyday exaggeration) · meltdown: a momentary crisis, a fit of crying or rage
meaning.tr: breakdown: ciddi psikolojik çöküş (gündelik dilde abartı olarak da) · meltdown: anlık kriz, ağlama/öfke nöbeti
meaning.de: breakdown: ein ernster seelischer Zusammenbruch (auch als Übertreibung im Alltag) · meltdown: eine kurze Krise, ein Wein- oder Wutanfall

equivalent.tr: sinir krizi geçirmek, çökmek; kriz geçirmek
equivalent.de: einen Nervenzusammenbruch haben; die Nerven verlieren, durchdrehen

literal.en: breakdown = a failure, a collapse · meltdown = (a reactor) melting

usage.en: have a (nervous/mental) breakdown · have a (complete) meltdown · be on the verge of a breakdown. The verb "break down" (start crying) is milder.
usage.tr: have a (nervous/mental) breakdown · have a (complete) meltdown · be on the verge of a breakdown. Fiil hâli "break down" (ağlamaya başlamak) daha hafiftir.

sentences.en: If I get one more email today, I'm going to [have a breakdown].
sentences.tr: Bugün bir e-posta daha gelirse sinir krizi geçireceğim.
sentences.de: Wenn ich heute noch eine E-Mail bekomme, kriege ich einen Nervenzusammenbruch.

sentences.en: I had a complete [meltdown] in the car after the exam.
sentences.tr: Sınavdan sonra arabada resmen kriz geçirdim.
sentences.de: Nach der Prüfung bin ich im Auto völlig zusammengebrochen.
